meta.name: JTAG UART
meta.description: A character link of a SoC (Logisim-evolution's SoC JTAG UART): a program writes characters over its SoC bus to a TTY and reads the characters of a keyboard through two FIFOs, with interrupt thresholds and an IRQ output; its terminal window can stand in for the keyboard and the TTY

bus.label: Bus
bus.title: The SoC bus the JTAG UART answers on (Logisim-evolution's Connected bus)

startAddress.label: Start address (hex)
startAddress.title: Address of the data register; the control register follows at +4 (8 bytes, word access only)

writeFifoSize.label: Write FIFO size
writeFifoSize.title: Characters the write FIFO (program to TTY) holds; a write to a full FIFO is lost

writeThreshold.label: Write IRQ threshold
writeThreshold.title: With the write interrupt enabled (control bit 1), WI is pending while the write FIFO holds at most this many characters

readFifoSize.label: Read FIFO size
readFifoSize.title: Characters the read FIFO (keyboard to program) holds; a character arriving at a full FIFO is lost

readThreshold.label: Read IRQ threshold
readThreshold.title: With the read interrupt enabled (control bit 0), RI is pending while the read FIFO has at most this many free places

terminal.label: Terminal
terminal.title: Opens a window that shows the characters sent to the TTY pins and sends what you type to the read FIFO

status.label: Status
status.title: The address range the JTAG UART answers, its FIFO levels and its control register

status.notConnected: Not connected to a bus: choose one in the Bus attribute

terminal.title: {{name}}: terminal
terminal.screenTitle: Characters the JTAG UART put on its TTY pins
terminal.placeholder: Type here: each key goes to the read FIFO (Enter = 10, Backspace = 8)
terminal.readFifoTitle: Characters typed or taken from the keyboard pins that the program has not read yet
terminal.writeFifoTitle: Characters the program wrote that have not reached the TTY pins yet (one per rising clock edge)
terminal.hint: The screen fills only while the clock runs: one character a rising edge. A reset empties both FIFOs and this screen.

circ.idTooLong: The bus id in the file is longer than {{max}} characters: the JTAG UART is not connected to a bus
circ.badStartAddress: "{{value}}" is not a 32-bit start address: 0x0 is used
circ.badFifoSize: "{{value}}" is not a FIFO size (8, 16, 32 … 32768): {{used}} is used
circ.badThreshold: "{{value}}" is not a whole number (a 32-bit IRQ threshold): {{used}} is used
